spew.definition: v. eject or send out in large quantities, also metaphorical
spew.translation:
vi. 呕吐, 喷涌
vt. 呕出, 喷
n. 呕吐物, 喷涌物

spewed.translation: v. 呕吐( spew的过去式和过去分词 ); （使某事物）喷出; 射出; （使）喷涌出

spewing.definition: p. pr.& vb. n. of Spew
spewing.translation: v. 呕吐( spew的现在分词 ); （使某事物）喷出; 射出; （使）喷涌出

spews.definition:
v expel or eject (saliva or phlegm or sputum) from the mouth
v eject or send out in large quantities, also metaphorical
v eject the contents of the stomach through the mouth
spews.translation: v. 呕吐( spew的第三人称单数 ); （使某事物）喷出; 射出; （使）喷涌出

spewy.definition: a. Wet; soggy; inclined to spew.
spewy.translation: a. 潮湿的,散发湿气的
